svg.title: Adversarial Control Matrix Overview Across 17 Scheduled Controls
svg.desc: Structured overview of all 17 adversarial controls grouped into five confound families — Geometric and Mechanical, Thermal and Gas Coupling, Electromagnetic and Timing, Analytical and Modal, and Procedural and Blinding — with their binding failure actions.
svg.text: Figure 5 · Adversarial Control Matrix (17 Pre-Scheduled Controls)
Every confound family is actively challenged before and during confirmatory runs. Numeric acceptance thresholds are locked during Stage 1 Qualification (TBD).
FAMILY 1 · GEOMETRIC & MECHANICAL
Mounting, Rotation & Swap (C1–C4)
• C1 Same-station lift-and-reseat repeatability
• C2 Azimuthal / polar sphere rotation test
• C3 Artifact A↔B physical swap (cancels
manufacturing asymmetry)
• C4 Cradle / kinematic mount interchange
Action: Halt & remediate seating bias
FAMILY 2 · THERMAL & GAS
Gradient, Drift & Acoustic Load (C5–C8)
• C5 Deliberate ΔT injection positive control
(verifies known ~10⁻⁴ K⁻¹ thermal slope)
• C6 Station A vs. B spatial ΔT mapping
• C7 Pressure / gas-coupling sweep check
• C8 Laser optical heating power sweep
Action: Exclude block / expand thermal u_B
FAMILY 3 · INSTRUMENT & TIMING
Channels, EM & Synchronization (C9–C12)
• C9 LDV / digitizer channel-swap control
• C10 Common-signal splitter zero-skew test
• C11 Excitation drive amplitude / nonlinearity
• C12 Ambient magnetic & RF pickup sweep
(plus VNA diagnostic cross-check)
Action: Disqualify run; recalibrate chain
FAMILY 4 · MODAL & ANALYTICAL
Mode Identity, Synthetic Injection & Estimator Lock (C13–C15)
• C13 Modal Assurance Criterion (MAC) & degenerate-mode splitting monitor
• C14 Synthetic frequency-shift injection test (recovers known ppb offsets cleanly)
• C15 Secondary estimator cross-check (flags ≥ locked sensitivity discrepancy;
guards against ~10 Hz method-dependent modal identification shifts)
Action: Reject mis-identified placement; never switch primary estimator post-hoc
FAMILY 5 · PROCEDURAL, REFERENCE & BLINDING
Sham Handling, Reference Artifact & Key Integrity (C16–C17)
• C16 Sham-move / zero-displacement negative control (same handling, same seat;
must yield null within repeatability floor)
• C17 Inert control artifact / blind-label integrity + SHA-256 custody audit
(verifies zero unblinding leakage before frozen analysis commit)
Action: Classify campaign Outcome 4 (Invalid); mandatory requalification
Binding Pre-Registered Failure Rule (No Post-Hoc Excusal)
If any positive control fails to detect a known injected shift, or any negative/sham/swap control exhibits an unmodeled offset exceeding its qualification-locked limit,
the affected confirmatory block is automatically classified Outcome 4 (Invalid) prior to unblinding. All failed controls are published in full with raw data.
